PAGLA / MLX

macOS local gateway core

API Reference → Docs → GitHub →

Local LLM Orchestration,
Stripped of Overhead.

PaglaMLX is a native macOS application that orchestrates and serves MLX-compatible language models locally on Apple Silicon. It manages background model server processes and runs a smart reverse proxy gateway at 127.0.0.1:2525/v1 that speaks both OpenAI and Anthropic API formats natively. Point any compatible developer client (like VS Code, Claude Desktop, or Continue) at the gateway to route requests dynamically to your active local model, or fall back to cloud providers when needed.

VERSION 1.3.0 Stable
DEFAULT PORT 2525 / v1
ARCHITECTURE Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4)

The Resolution Architecture

01 / EXACT MATCH

Local routes.json

Exact matches loaded configurations instantly.

02 / SUBSTRING

Name Contained

Partial model tags resolve directly to similar backends.

03 / PREFIX ROUTE

Cloud Redirection

Checks cloud prefixes like `gpt-` or `claude-` to bypass local server.

04 / SESSION FALLBACK

Stickiness Priority

Reuses previously connected session endpoints.

Getting Started Offline

PAGLA INTEGRATION TERMINAL 
# Verify gateway health
curl http://127.0.0.1:2525/v1

# Dispatch query to Auto-Router
curl http://127.0.0.1:2525/v1/chat/completions \
  -d '{
    "model": "auto",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is local MLX?"}]
  }'
